rule: Judge the piece itself, not the sticker.
checks: Country on the sticker tells season, not grade.
Sticker code: five digits starting 9 is organic.

rule: Judge by seal and smell, not color alone.
checks: Take a sealed package that is not leaking.
Pass on any pack with an off smell.

rule: Read species, wild or farmed, and origin.
checks: Counter fish sits on plenty of ice.
Counter fish smells clean and briny, never ammonia.

rule: Believe the back when front and back disagree.
checks: Read “natural” as marketing with little definition.

rule: Read the back; at bins, pick busy ones.
checks: Read ingredients, added sugars and serving size.
Rancid bin nuts smell of paint or crayon.
Drips or an off smell mean it thawed.
